description: Set light layer options (Layer > Light Settings, and Light Options in the Timeline): light type, intensity, colour, cone angle and feather, falloff type, radius and falloff distance, casts shadows, shadow darkness and diffusion, Point of Interest, and an environment light's source layer. Values are keyframed when the property is animated or a time is given

castsShadows.description: Casts Shadows (spot, parallel and environment lights). Layers also need Material Options > Casts Shadows on

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

layers.description: Which light layers. Give indexes (1-based, from list_layers), names, or selected: true

lightSource.description: Environment lights: index of the 2D layer in the same composition to light the scene with (Light Options > Source)

pointOfInterest.description: Point of Interest [x, y, z] in pixels, for two-node cameras and lights

radius.description: Radius in pixels, where light is at full intensity before falloff

time.description: Seconds: set keyframes at this time. Omit to set the static value, or a keyframe at the current time when the property is already animated

name: set_light_options
title: Set Light Options
